name: Spectrum plan segments a band overlaps, with their services and footnote text
sql: SELECT p.freq_start_hz AS min_hz, p.freq_end_hz AS max_hz, p.services_json AS services_json, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('ref', f.value, 'text', COALESCE((SELECT au.footnote_text FROM spectrum_australian_footnotes au WHERE au.footnote_ref = f.value LIMIT 1), (SELECT it.footnote_text FROM spectrum_international_footnotes it WHERE it.footnote_ref = f.value LIMIT 1)))) FROM json_each(COALESCE(p.footnotes_json, '[]')) f) AS footnotes_json FROM spectrum_allocations p WHERE p.freq_start_hz <= {hi_hz} AND p.freq_end_hz >= {lo_hz} ORDER BY p.freq_start_hz, p.freq_end_hz
